params.prompt:
Identity and wardrobe replacement in the supplied source music video. This is a video edit, not a new scene.

REFERENCES: @Image1 = character sheet of CLAUDE, the fictional adult man in a dark olive-green velvet three-piece suit, cream shirt and burgundy tie, with a long freckled face, small round gold glasses, a thin ginger moustache and two tall rounded ginger hair columns separated by a bare central strip. @Image2 = JEAN PHIL, man with a honey-blond bob, curled handlebar moustache and brown houndstooth jacket. @Image3 = LEOPOLD, man with dark brown skin, very long dark curly hair, round gold glasses and burgundy velvet blazer. @Image4 = albino man with long crimped platinum-white hair, gold aviator glasses and burgundy suit. @Image5 = man with a black pageboy bob in a burgundy medieval velvet tunic with a gold chain.

CASTING: replace the lead dancer in the red leather jacket, the man at the center of the choreography in the foggy street who leads the gang, with Claude from @Image1 in EVERY shot, wearing his olive-green velvet suit, with exactly the same dance moves, steps, arm movements, head moves and timing. Replace every gang member and dancer around him with a varied crew of the eccentric characters from @Image2 to @Image5, mixed with newly invented eccentric retro 1970s characters (bobs, mullets, big moustaches, vintage suits), each keeping his exact position and choreography. Keep the fog, the lighting, the street and every camera move.

The SOURCE VIDEO is the sole master for its complete duration: framing, camera, every cut, timing, body positions, dance moves, gestures, contacts, expressions and audio. The character sheets give identity and wardrobe ONLY; in their full-body views the faces are masked in white on purpose, so take faces ONLY from the large close-up portraits and never render a white or blank face. Replace, never add; keep Claude identical in every shot and never reveal any original face or red jacket. Preserve the original audio. No reference-sheet panels, labels or added watermark. Photorealistic music-video integration.
